newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWF estimates higher Australian barley production.
newsitem.headline: AWF estimates higher Australian barley production.

text.p: Privately-held agriculture analyst Australian Wheat Forecasters Pty Ltd (AWF) said on Wednesday that Australian barley production in 1996/97 (April-March) was likely to be 6.217 million tonnes, rising to 6.740 million tonnes in 1997/98.
The latest 1996/97 forecast compares with AWF's earlier estimate of 6.15 million tonnes, while this is the forecaster's first 1997/98 estimate.

It said the area sown to barley was likely to rise to 3.594 million hectares next year from 3.270 million hectares this year, reflecting growers confidence in the marketing and price performance of various regulated industry boards.
